layers.note: First layer described as 'Gravia' (graves). Depth 0.00–1.80 m read from field log profunditat column. Consistent with Albarà entry: 1.80 ml de perf. en graves entre 0-20m.

Second layer described as 'Gravia Carbonatada'. Depth_to_m of 4.00 m is uncertain — the lower boundary is not clearly legible; could be 4.00 m. No 'Unitat litològica' column visible; both layers treated as geological level 1 per fallback rule.

spt_results.note: SPT blow counts read from 'Colpeig' column: values appear to be approximately 24, 3x (34?), 28, 30. The second value is particularly unclear — could be 34 or 3¼ notation. n_spt calculated as sum of blows[1]+blows[2] = 34+28 = 62. Depth 1.00–1.60 m inferred from 'Mostres' column entry '1ca-1.60, S.P.T-1'. Depth_from_m preferred as 1.00 (round value) per depth precision rules, though handwriting is ambiguous.

sondeig_tests.extraction_notes: Three document pages analyzed: (1) Albarà delivery note, (2) Field log sheet (Full de camp sondeig a rotació), (3) Hand-drawn site sketch. Borehole S-1 drilled 06-10-2025. Total drilled depth from Albarà confirmed as 1.80 m in gravels (0-20m category). Field log suggests drilling continued into carbonated gravels below 1.80 m but exact final depth is unclear — possibly 4.00 m. No 'Unitat litològica' column present; num_geological_levels set to 1 per fallback rule. SPT blow counts are partially legible. Water level noted on field sheet as 'Anbes/Ambés B.llec +/o' — likely a location reference rather than a numeric water level depth; set to null. Driller: Daniel Fernandez/Farrandes. Equipment: ML76A. Client: G3. Site: C/Antoni Bellet, Bell-lloc.

extraction_notes: Document is a handwritten field log photographed at an angle with some distortion, making several values difficult to read with certainty. The Albarà (page 1) provides useful cross-validation. Key uncertainties: (1) exact final borehole depth, (2) SPT blow counts — second value particularly unclear, (3) lower boundary of second soil layer, (4) driller surname spelling. Site sketch (page 3) confirms single borehole S-1 at the C/Antoni Bellet / C/Mestre Ramon Ortez plot. Language of document: Catalan.
